# Bar stool: a red round seat on a steel post and foot. Generated by make_env.py. Up Z.
new
material new Seat --base-color 0.7098 0.2549 0.1922 --no-slot
material new Post --base-color 0.3333 0.3765 0.4902 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Seat --vertices 10 --radius 0.24 --depth 0.12 --location 0 0 0.7
material assign Seat
add mesh cylinder --name Pole --vertices 6 --radius 0.055 --depth 0.62 --location 0 0 0.33
material assign Post
add mesh cylinder --name Foot --vertices 10 --radius 0.22 --depth 0.05 --location 0 0 0.025
material assign Post
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select Seat Pole Foot
active Seat
join
shade flat
export stool.glb
